correctness.rationale: The displayed matrix equals \(uI+v(I_p\otimes J_p)+J\) by the three gcd classes. Its rational eigenvalues \(u\), \(\alpha\), and \(\beta\) give the nonzero determinant. For \(\ell\ne p\), averaging by \(p\) is integral over \(\mathbb Z_\ell\), with local Smith factors \(u\) of multiplicity \(p(p-1)\), \(\alpha\) of multiplicity \(p-1\), and \(\beta\) once. At \(\ell=p\), the one-index-per-block pivot satisfies \(P\equiv J-I\pmod p\) and is invertible; the Schur complement is \(u(I+RWP^{-1}R^{\mathsf T})\) and reduces to \(p\) blocks \(I_{p-1}+J_{p-1}\). Rank and exact determinant valuation yield \(0\) (multiplicity \(p\)), \(a\) (multiplicity \(p(p-2)\)), and \(a+1\) (multiplicity \(p\)) as the \(p\)-valuations. Coprimalities \(\gcd(v,\beta)\mid p^2\) and \(\gcd(c,\beta)\mid p^2\) identify every other local Smith valuation; the proposed factors divide consecutively. The embedded independent modular checker passed 4,499 grouped exact assertions on seven test cases; finite cases are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This completely classifies the integral cokernel and all congruence obstructions for a natural arithmetic cyclic convolution kernel, uniformly in every odd prime and every positive power, at the first nonsquarefree order \(p^2\). It separates the unexpectedly stable p-primary structure from prime-to-\(p\) torsion in the full invariant factors; neither the obvious Fourier eigenvalues nor determinant/last-factor formulas recover that information.
